Q8031.reason: The wife may already be infected through unprotected contact, so the duty to prevent harm to an identifiable third party (nonmaleficence) overrides the patient's autonomy and confidentiality.

Q8438.reason: Nuremberg and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights treated rights as existing above positive state law, which is what revived natural-law thinking after WWII.

Q6016.reason: Substrate-level glycolysis nets 2 ATP from glucose (4 made minus 2 spent) and 3 from glycogen because phosphorylase uses Pi and skips the hexokinase ATP cost.
